newlyPassingCases.name: an agent's language: in its prompt once and the same every turn, shown, changed and cleared by PATCH, refused when junk
existing agents recover from static fallback on their next call; tenant and scope keys never exchange
an azure model without a deployment, a refused key, a missing deployment and a rate limit each end the run with Azure's reason
a tenant on the platform's keys runs azure models the platform deploys, through the deployment, billed at the catalog's price
if DeepSeek's endpoint refuses anyway, the same request is asked again: no host kept off, no order
DeepSeek's refusal as OpenRouter's Chat Completions gives it (127 characters) is classed and retried as it was; the answer names its host
the default is for agents being made: an upsert or a definition applied that names no model leaves an existing agent's
a Codex model on a tenant's endpoint gets the ChatGPT backend's own request, with a placeholder account for the endpoint to replace
a tenant endpoint's errors end the turn with its message, without retries
OpenRouter models on a tenant's endpoint use its Responses API, reasoning carried back, and compact through it
a Bedrock model on a tenant's endpoint gets Converse's own request at its region's path, unsigned, with its signatures sent back
on a platform key a response is billed at the catalog's price, whatever the agent's stored model says, and one without usage is charged an estimate
an agent's maxOutputTokens and temperature go on its model calls, are refused where its model takes none, and stay its own
over the API: the lookup's price reaches an end user's hold, so a dear model is refused where the mid-range price would have started
a provider that refuses a forced tool_choice is asked again without it; forcing stops after three requests
codeMode: false leaves out codemode and the runtime's code rules; with no tools at all, the prompt is the instructions and the sender note
a prompt with output ends on a final_output call that fits its schema, which the outcome returns
a structured run the model ends in text is reminded once, then fails with output_missing; a prompt without output takes the tool away
output is refused unless it is a schema for an object, on a prompt that starts its own turn
a tenant with no OpenRouter key falls to what it holds; an upsert keeps the alias, and naming a model leaves it
over the API: Particle's failed attempt releases its end user's hold and costs nothing; only the model that answered is charged

knownFollowUp.finding: The 102 KB compaction contract passes. Larger accepted prompts still use whole request records and Pi rows; canonical fingerprints duplicate text. Full 6 MiB input support requires a separate storage-size test and chunked or offloaded persistence. Local workerd and deployed Durable Object size ceilings can differ.
knownFollowUp.basis: Code review; maximum-size behavior was not exercised by this run.
